name: Ezumi Mikihito
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'benevolence' on his body.
He has good reflexes and is the brotherly type that is easy to talk too.
Thinking things through isn't his strong suit, he has a straightforward personality and is surprisingly easily moved to tears.
translation:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'benevolence' on his body.
He has good reflexes and is the brotherly type that is easy to talk too.
Thinking things through isn't his strong suit, he has a straightforward personality and is surprisingly easily moved to tears.
